title: glTF scene loader uses wrong color space

labels.name: A-Rendering
labels.description: Drawing game state to the screen

labels.name: A-Assets
labels.description: Load files from disk to use for things like images, models, and sounds

body:
## Bevy version

0.9.1

## What you did

Loaded a glTF scene

```rust
use bevy::prelude::*;

fn main() {
    App::new()
        .add_plugins(DefaultPlugins)
        .add_startup_system(load_scene)
        .run()
}

fn load_scene(mut commands: Commands, assets: Res<AssetServer>) {
    commands.spawn(SceneBundle {
        scene: assets.load("repro.gltf#Scene0"),
        ..Default::default()
    });
}

```

## What went wrong

<details>
<summary>The colors of all of the models were different than they were in Blender:</summary>

Blender:
![cyan-blender](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28542452/205402363-2d2677dd-07fa-4008-a7d5-74ede1eb2c9e.png)
Bevy:
![cyan-bevy](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28542452/205402361-ba6dd161-ee70-4501-8642-5c556199eda4.png)
Blender:
![grey-blender](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28542452/205402367-96194bcf-3886-4ecd-b06e-f6c6cdc630bd.png)
Bevy:
![grey-bevy](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28542452/205402366-522db831-de36-47be-84dd-b781014e0b87.png)
Blender:
![lime-blender](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28542452/205402370-34551c10-c3c2-4780-9858-de049912a943.png)
Bevy:
![lime-bevy](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28542452/205402369-bca8045e-e313-4f92-9c83-8b8a7b7091c4.png)

</details>

## Additional information

Bevy's glTF loader [interprets colors in the sRGB color space,](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/919188074c9d0009ae84bfa1a69ff04ae8e80774/crates/bevy_gltf/src/loader.rs#L672) which is incorrect - glTF mandates that colors be specified in linear color space.

Initially I assumed that Bevy was correct and Blender was at fault, but this was disproved shortly after I [reported it as a bug in Blender](https://developer.blender.org/T102905).
